title: Juicy Molten Slovakian Pork Stew
description: A savory and molten one-pot Slovakian dish featuring pork, miniature marshmallows, and a lacquer glaze, made diabetic friendly, cooked in a fondue pot. This stew is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Slovakian cuisine.
instructions: Heat the fondue pot to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the pork shoulder to the fondue pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the fondue pot and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic to the fondue pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, carrots, potatoes, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the fondue pot.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to 200 degrees Fahrenheit and simmer for 2 hours.
Add the miniature marshmallows to the fondue pot and cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Brush the lacquer glaze over the pork and vegetables.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
